> This page contains a short description of the contents, reading instructions and additional material for each lecture.

### Schedule
The course schedule can be found on [TimeEdit](https://cloud.timeedit.net/su/web/stud1/s.html?tab=3&object=cevt_39011_HT2025&startDate=20250802&endDate=20260131&type=courseevent&h=t&l=en). 

### Literature
- The **BL** listed below are section numbers from the course book Villani (2025a). [Bayesian Learning](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/BayesBook.pdf).
- The **BLprequel** listed below are section numbers from a book [Bayesian Learning - the prequel](https://github.com/mattiasvillani/BayesianLearningBook/raw/main/pdf/PreBayesBook.pdf).
- The **BDA** listed below are section numbers from the course book Gelman, Carlin, Stern, Dunson, Vehtari, Rubin (2014). [Bayesian Data Analysis](http://www.stat.columbia.edu/~gelman/book/BDA3.pdf).

### Lecture contents

**Lecture 0 (Recorded, no physical class) - The likelihood function. Information. Basic Monte Carlo simulation.**\
Read: BL 1.1-1.3, BL 10.1-10.3, BLprequel 8.3, 8.4, 8.6 (check that you know the concepts) | [Slides](/slides/BL_L0.pdf) \
Interactive (check that you know the concepts): [MLE for Bernoulli data](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/maximum-likelihood-bernoulli-data) | [MLE for Poisson](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/maximum-likelihood-for-iid-poisson-data) | [Second derivative as function curvature](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/second-derivative-measures-the-curvature-of-a-function) | [Likelihood and Information](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/likelihood-and-information) | [Law of large numbers](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/law-large-numbers) | [Central limit theorem](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/central-limit-theorem) \

**Lecture 1 - Subjective probability and Bayesian learning. Bernoulli. Gaussian with known variance.**\
Read: BL 1.4-1.5, 2.1-2.3 |  [Slides](/slides/BL_L1.pdf) \
Interactive: [Bayes theorem for events](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayes-theorem-for-events) | [Bernoulli data](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayesian-inference-for-bernoulli-iid-data) | [Normal data - known variance](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayes-iid-gaussian-known-var) \

**Lecture 2 - Poisson. Summarizing a posterior distribution. Priors.**\
Read: BL 2.2-2.5, BL 4.1-4.8 |  [Slides](/slides/BL_L2.pdf) \
Interactive: [Poisson data](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayesian-inference-for-iid-poisson-counts) | [Credible intervals](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayesian-credible-intervals) \

**Lecture 2 - Marginalization. Gaussian with unknown variance. Multinomial. Multivariate normal.**\
Read: BL 3.1-3.3, 3.5-3.6 |  [Slides](/slides/BL_L3.pdf) \
Interactive: [Normal data - unknown variance](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/bayesian-inference-for-gaussian-iid-data) | [Scaled inverse chi2](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/scaled-inverse-chi-2-distribution) | [Dirichlet distribution](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/dirichlet-distribution) | [Multinomial data](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/multinomial-dirichlet)  | [Multivariate normal distribution](https://observablehq.com/@mattiasvillani/multivariate-normal-distribution) \
